title: Yosi Risha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Eikhah Rabbah, chapter 3, 17, relates that Rabbi Abbahu went to Botzrah and was received by Yosi Risha. He brought before him eighty kinds of birds’ brains and said to him: “Let the Rabbi not be angry with me, because I did not hunt much today.” Why is he called Yosi Risha? Because all his food consisted only of birds’ brains (from the word rosh, “head”). This is not Yosef Rishba, for he lived in the time of Rabbi, as explained in his entry.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman cites chapter 3, 17. The episode appears at [Eikhah Rabbah 3:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Eikhah_Rabbah.3.6) in the Midrash Rabbah — TE edition; its numbering differs from Hyman’s.
